nativeWorker.build: cargo build --offline -p cw-designcraft-engine through the host low-impact wrapper (one job, at most two CPUs, nice 10)
nativeWorker.operation: save_copy delegates to upstream file.saveACopy with a unique private staging path and leaves the saved-state pointer unchanged

proof: Original browser Open chooser copies input to the session root and the native worker opens it
Original File Save a Copy shortcut/dialog reaches the native file.saveACopy command
Native byte count and atomic server workspace write are acknowledged before success
Current document remains dirty and keeps its original filename
Existing target is rejected and the retained copy reopens through the original chooser
limitations: Candidate is unregistered; DesignCraft remains planned
Only one-spread native .designcraft documents, server destination and workspace retention are covered
Laptop output acknowledgement, other retention policies, recovery, folder permissions/on-demand/hybrid and full UI parity are pending
